rows.sample: The connection froze on your aunt’s face, mouth open. You said hello to the frozen picture for four minutes.

rows.title: Fully clothed
rows.sample: You ran straight into the lake with all your clothes on. A very wet adult fished you out.

rows.title: Garage full of product
rows.sample: You now have a garage full of crypto courses that nobody will buy, and three fewer friends.

rows.title: Gift card fiasco
rows.sample: You bought $184 in gift cards and read the numbers over the phone. The "tax agency" hung up. It was a scam.

rows.title: Goal!
rows.sample: Forty people screamed at once when the goal went in, and the roof nearly came off. You hugged people you had never met.

rows.title: Gone
rows.sample: You wired $1,500 to an account number the caller read out twice, very slowly. You do not have a grandson in trouble. You'd been scammed.

rows.title: Gone viral
rows.sample: Your footage of the earthquake went viral and was picked up by the national news!

rows.title: Good Sense
rows.sample: You put the radio in the drawer and slept like a log. On the weekend you listened in the afternoon with the window open, and nobody minded.

rows.title: Good eater
rows.sample: You ate the pumpkin mush. Your mother gave you a big smile and a kiss.

rows.title: Good training
rows.sample: You worked with Biscuit on its behavior. It seems to be learning!

rows.title: Granny Knows Best
rows.sample: A mustard poultice, onion syrup, a hot toddy of honey and lemon and a week under three blankets: you were better by Sunday, and your grandmother was insufferable.

rows.title: Grass Is Greener
rows.sample: You kept your lawn and your standing in the garden club, and paid a bit extra for vegetables. The neighbors did not say anything, but the bean rows next door were a quiet rebuke.

rows.title: Great Night
rows.sample: You didn’t win, but you laughed until dawn, ate your weight in snacks and found out that your friends can be terrifying in a team shooter.

rows.title: Grounded
rows.sample: You strolled in two hours late. Your record player was confiscated for a month.

rows.title: Group chat gold
rows.sample: Your friends roasted it mercilessly. You laughed until you cried.

rows.title: Growing up
rows.sample: You told Mr. Biscuits it was time to go. You feel oddly mature.

rows.title: Happily ever after
rows.sample: You danced all night at Maja's wedding. Your gift was a hit.

rows.title: Heart of gold
rows.sample: You bought him a plate of a chicken parmy and sat with him while he ate. His name is Harrison and he used to be a jazz drummer.

rows.title: Helping hand
rows.sample: You spent the day helping the neighbors clean up. Somebody gave you a snack and called you a hero.

rows.title: Homemaker
rows.sample: You set up an elaborate pretend household. The stuffed animals pay rent.

rows.title: Hospitalized
rows.sample: By the time the ambulance arrived, Osman had passed out. They pulled through after a week in the hospital.

rows.title: Hung up
rows.sample: You told Marina to call someone else and went back to sleep.

rows.title: Hurt feelings
rows.sample: You told Karla the truth. They wore a hat for a month and barely spoke to you.

rows.title: Hurt on Set
rows.sample: You worked through the injury. The client was pleased, and the strain showed.

rows.title: Hype squad
rows.sample: You cheered Esther on until security escorted you both out.

rows.title: Ice ball
rows.sample: Someone packed an ice ball and nailed you in the eye. Snow day ruined.

rows.title: In Hiding
rows.sample: You slipped out of town before dawn and found a hiding place far from home. Now you just have to stay out of sight until the war is over.

rows.title: Influencer
rows.sample: You took a hundred selfies, all of them from below your chin with your thumb over the lens. You posted every one.

rows.title: Inked
rows.sample: You got my own name, in case I forget tattooed on your arm. Your kids are mortified.

rows.title: Inner screaming
rows.sample: You suffered in silence. Your eye has developed a twitch.

rows.title: Into the fire
rows.sample: You tossed the letter into the fire. The nobleman will have to bribe his own jailers.

rows.title: It's mutual!
rows.sample: Thomas replied: "I think you're cute too." You're officially dating!

rows.title: Jingle jangle
rows.sample: You gnawed your mother's house keys. They were sticky for a week.

rows.title: Just friends
rows.sample: You told Chebet you'd rather stay just friends. Awkward.

rows.title: Just say no
rows.sample: You said no. Dragoș called you lame, but you feel great about it.

rows.title: Justice served
rows.sample: You punched Rafael square in the nose and won the fight!

rows.title: Justice?
rows.sample: The jury found Emilia Bianchi guilty of stealing 400 garden gnomes. You lay awake wondering if you got it wrong.

rows.title: Last One Standing
rows.sample: You carried a monitor the size of a small refrigerator up the stairs, and you won the final round at 5 a.m. You will not be able to lift your arms tomorrow.

rows.title: Law enforcement FTW
rows.sample: The police arrived and caught a parking attendant in the act!

rows.title: Learner
rows.sample: You practiced in an empty parking lot and only hit one shopping cart.

rows.title: Left, right
rows.sample: You marched around the living room in a perfectly straight line for an hour.

rows.title: Legendary prank
rows.sample: You helped cover Mr. Kiplagat's car with 3,000 sticky notes. A work of art.

rows.title: Letter to the Editor
rows.sample: You wrote a letter asking why the world needed so many bombs. The paper printed it under the headline "Young Reader Worries." You felt a little less helpless.

rows.title: Living Room Workout
rows.sample: You pushed the coffee table aside and followed the instructor on screen. Your cat watched in disbelief from the sofa.

rows.title: Local legend
rows.sample: You leaned in. A local car dealership hired you to do the same thing in their commercial!

rows.title: Logistics
rows.sample: You booked Karla a ride home and went back to sleep. Efficient.

rows.title: Love at first sight
rows.sample: You and Răzvan talked until the restaurant closed. You're officially dating!

rows.title: Loyalty
rows.sample: You put the people who actually had your back first. Your best friend saw it, said nothing and bought you a milkshake the next day.

rows.title: Lunch buddy
rows.sample: You invited Dragoș to sit with you. You hit it off immediately!

rows.title: Magical
rows.sample: You had a unicorn party with a rainbow cake. Glitter will be found in the carpet for years.

rows.title: Marching for Peace
rows.sample: You gave out leaflets on the high street, signed petitions and walked with banners. Many people ignored you, some thanked you and one threw a tomato. You came home sunburnt and unrepentant.

rows.title: Midnight Confessions
rows.sample: You talked about everything and nothing until 1:30 a.m. Your friendships have never been closer, and you cannot keep your eyes open in third period.

rows.title: Missed it
rows.sample: Mio's stories were amazing. Too bad you completely missed the essay instructions.

rows.title: Model student
rows.sample: You answered seriously and correctly. The teacher gave you a nod of approval.

rows.title: Monster check
rows.sample: You toddled into your parents' room. Babar grumbled but checked under your bed for monsters.

rows.title: Moral compass
rows.sample: You called them out for stealing. They rolled their eyes and put it back.

rows.title: Mummified
rows.sample: You helped cover Mr. Ilić's car with 3,000 sticky notes. A work of art.

rows.title: Mutually assured destruction
rows.sample: You found Mike's diary and read the juiciest parts at dinner. Nobody won.

rows.title: Namaste
rows.sample: You did yoga all week. Your chakras have never been more aligned, and the cell has never smelled worse.
